places: Pico de Teide (Tenerife) on Canary Islands

fields.climate: temperate; clear, hot summers in interior, more moderate and cloudy along coast; cloudy, cold winters in interior, partly cloudy and cool along coast
fields.terrain: large, flat to dissected plateau surrounded by rugged hills; Pyrenees Mountains in north
fields.hazards: periodic droughts, occasional flooding; volcanism: volcanic activity in the Canary Islands, located off Africa's northwest coast…
fields.resources: coal, lignite, iron ore, copper, lead, zinc, uranium, tungsten, mercury, pyrites, magnesite, fluorspar, gypsum, sepiolite, kaolin, potash, hydropower, arable land
fields.farm: milk, olives, pork, grapes, wheat, tomatoes, barley, sugar beets, maize, oranges
fields.exports: cars, packaged medicine, refined petroleum, vehicle parts/accessories, garments
fields.industries: textiles and apparel (including footwear), food and beverages, metals and metal manufactures, chemicals, shipbuilding, automobiles, machine tools, tourism, clay and refractory products, footwear…
fields.languages: Castilian Spanish (official) 74%, Catalan (official in Catalonia, the Balearic Islands, and the Valencian Community) 17%, Galician (official in Galicia) 7%, Basque (official in the Basque Country and…
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 58.2%, atheist 16.2%, agnostic 10.8%, other 2.7%, non-believer 10.5%, unspecified 1.7%
